title: SPKI DER curve_id check after wc_EccPublicKeyDecode prevents cross-curve substitution
description: wc_EccPublicKeyDecode accepts any curve embedded in the DER without checking it against the expected curve_id. Without the post-decode wc_ecc_get_curve_id() comparison, a P-384 SPKI DER could be silently imported into a P-256 context, potentially causing undefined behavior or a FIPS boundary violation. A contributor may suggest removing the check as redundant with wolfCrypt. It is not redundant. Keep it.
